module.title: TeNPy tensor-network simulation library
module.expensive_path: Tensor contractions, MPS canonicalisation, DMRG/TEBD sweeps and time evolution
module.rationale: TeNPy is one cohesive Python/Cython package whose algorithms share MPS, tensor, lattice and model contracts; splitting algorithms or model families would create stages and check families rather than independent repository-like modules.
excluded: Documentation, notebooks and optional plotting/IO integrations are outside the source module; their official examples remain survey inputs.
hazards: Cython extension build requires a complete C++ toolchain; optional h5py/pyyaml/psutil dependencies affect some tests.

approval.human_ref: 用户明确要求开始并完成 TeNPy，批准 whole-codebase tenpy module。
